metadata.title: मक्का, बाजरे और जवार की रोटी ऐसे बनाओगे तो कभी नहीं टूटेगी | Makka And Jawar Roti making
metadata.description: Making roti of Makka, Jawar and Bajara is a difficult task for those who doesn't know the art of making it. The catch is in the kneading the atta with the water at a right temperature. In this episode you can learn making the roti in perfect size and shape.
